hooks.command:
/bin/sh -c 'set -m; ( REPO_CONTEXT="$(/usr/bin/env -i PATH="/usr/bin:/bin" GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="/dev/null" GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1" GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0" /usr/bin/git -C "$PWD" --no-optional-locks -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null rev-parse --show-toplevel --absolute-git-dir --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || true)"; OLD_IFS="$IFS"; IFS="
"; set -f; set -- $REPO_CONTEXT; set +f; IFS="$OLD_IFS"; WORK_ROOT="/.tmb-no-checkout"; ATTESTED_GIT_DIR=""; ATTESTED_COMMON_DIR=""; if [ "$#" -eq 3 ]; then WORK_ROOT="$1"; ATTESTED_GIT_DIR="$2"; ATTESTED_COMMON_DIR="$3"; fi; NODE_LAUNCHER="$(command -v node 2>/dev/null || true)"; PLUGIN_CANON=""; LAUNCHER_CANON=""; case "$NODE_LAUNCHER" in /*) CANONICAL_PATHS="$(/bin/realpath "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$NODE_LAUNCHER" 2>/dev/null || true)"; IFS="
"; set -f; set -- $CANONICAL_PATHS; set +f; IFS="$OLD_IFS"; if [ "$#" -eq 2 ]; then PLUGIN_CANON="$1"; LAUNCHER_CANON="$2"; fi ;; *) PLUGIN_CANON="$(/bin/realpath "$PLUGIN_ROOT" 2>/dev/null || true)" ;; esac; case "$LAUNCHER_CANON" in "$WORK_ROOT"/*|"$PLUGIN_CANON"/*|*/node_modules/.bin/*|*/.git/*) LAUNCHER_CANON="" ;; esac; if [ -z "$LAUNCHER_CANON" ]; then for NODE_CANDIDATE in /usr/bin/node /bin/node /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node; do if [ -f "$NODE_CANDIDATE" ] && [ -x "$NODE_CANDIDATE" ]; then LAUNCHER_CANON="$(/bin/realpath "$NODE_CANDIDATE" 2>/dev/null || true)"; break; fi; done; fi; NODE_CANON="$LAUNCHER_CANON"; case "$LAUNCHER_CANON" in */.asdf/shims/*|*/.mise/shims/*|*/mise/shims/*|*/.volta/bin/*) NODE_BIN="$("$LAUNCHER_CANON" -p "process.execPath" 2>/dev/null || true)"; NODE_CANON=""; case "$NODE_BIN" in /*) if [ -f "$NODE_BIN" ] && [ -x "$NODE_BIN" ]; then NODE_CANON="$(/bin/realpath "$NODE_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi ;; esac ;; esac; case "$NODE_CANON" in "$WORK_ROOT"/*|"$PLUGIN_CANON"/*|*/node_modules/.bin/*|*/.git/*) NODE_CANON="" ;; esac; if [ -n "$NODE_CANON" ] && [ -f "$NODE_CANON" ] && [ -x "$NODE_CANON" ]; then exec /usr/bin/env -i PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin" TMB_CODEX_HOOK_HOST_PATH="${PATH}" TMB_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT="$WORK_ROOT" TMB_CODEX_HOOK_GIT_DIR="$ATTESTED_GIT_DIR" TMB_CODEX_HOOK_COMMON_DIR="$ATTESTED_COMMON_DIR" PLUGIN_ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT}" PLUGIN_DATA="${PLUGIN_DATA:-}" "$NODE_CANON" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/adapters/codex/hooks/dispatcher.mjs" --policy-sha256 b90959994a6963ee36ce0e246320114429c43179a15eb2c16e1c613a0fb9cfd9; else false; fi ) <&0 & HOOK_PID=$!; ( TIMED_OUT=0; trap "if [ \"\$TIMED_OUT\" -eq 0 ]; then /bin/kill -TERM \"\$SLEEP_PID\" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 0; fi" TERM HUP INT; /bin/sleep 4 & SLEEP_PID=$!; wait "$SLEEP_PID"; TIMED_OUT=1; /bin/kill -TERM "-$HOOK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; /bin/sleep 0.2 & SLEEP_PID=$!; wait "$SLEEP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; /bin/kill -KILL "-$HOOK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 124 ) </dev/null & WATCH_PID=$!; set +m; wait "$HOOK_PID" 2>/dev/null; HOOK_STATUS=$?; /bin/kill -TERM "$WATCH_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$WATCH_PID" 2>/dev/null; WATCH_STATUS=$?; if [ "$HOOK_STATUS" -ne 0 ] || [ "$WATCH_STATUS" -eq 124 ]; then printf "%s\n" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"TMB-CODEX-HOOK: dispatcher process failed or exceeded the internal 4 second launcher timeout\"}}"; fi; exit 0'
